scripts.clean: npm run clean:linux && npm run clean:mac
scripts.build:mac: npm run clean:mac && mkdir -p /tmp/mac-sqlite && cd /tmp/mac-sqlite && npm init -y && npm_config_platform=darwin npm_config_arch=x64 npm install sqlite3 && cd - && pkg backend/server.js --config package.json --targets node18-macos-x64 --no-bytecode --out-path dist/mac && mkdir -p dist/mac/node_modules && cp -r /tmp/mac-sqlite/node_modules/sqlite3 dist/mac/node_modules/
scripts.build:linux: npm run clean:linux && pkg backend/server.js --config package.json --targets node18-linux-x64 --out-path dist/linux && mkdir -p dist/linux/node_modules && cp -r node_modules/sqlite3 dist/linux/node_modules/
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:linux && npm run build:mac
